name: Altus front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 122 g for the Altus LT FD-AT12 lower-inlet clamp assembly with a 1 1/8 inch (28.575 mm) band and 14T front capacity. This is the historical road component, not later MTB Altus.
